claim.cs: Deterministické vyhledávání symbolů a AST indexace v lokálním MCP serveru bez povinné cloudové inference.
claim.en: Deterministic symbol retrieval and AST indexing in local MCP server without mandatory cloud inference.

evidence.method: Public GitHub release v5.1.4 tag and assets
limitations: v6.1.0 remains a development candidate (RC) awaiting source freeze

evidence.method: AST symbol lookup test suite with ground truth resolution on PHP, Python, and TypeScript fixtures
limitations: Lexical and AST index only; semantic embeddings are an optional local extension

claim.cs: Desktopové rozhraní pro Mutagen se stavovým automatem obousměrné synchronizace a forwardingem soketů.
claim.en: Desktop interface for Mutagen with bidirectional file sync state machine and network socket forwarding.

evidence.method: Public GitHub release v9.1.1 with verified cross-platform desktop build assets
limitations: Requires local Mutagen CLI binary installed on the host operating system

evidence.method: Pure state machine transition tests verifying conflict resolution and reconnect recovery
limitations: GUI orchestrates Mutagen sessions; underlying transport is executed by Mutagen core

claim.cs: Automatizovaná správa homelab infrastruktury přes Ansible a Proxmox s deterministickým pořadím obnovy.
claim.en: Automated homelab infrastructure management via Ansible and Proxmox with deterministic recovery ordering.

evidence.method: Rehearsed cold restore test on isolated Proxmox node following designated dependency order
limitations: Private IP addresses, internal hostnames, and credentials redacted from public documentation

evidence.method: Client-side interactive graph model demonstrating upstream dependency failures
limitations: Curated educational topology; does not execute live network requests against home servers

claim.cs: Server-side rendering v CakePHP 5 s maximální statickou analýzou, zero-error PHPStan a reprodukovatelným offline náhledem.
claim.en: Server-side rendering in CakePHP 5 with maximum level static analysis, zero-error PHPStan, and reproducible offline preview.

evidence.method: PHPStan max + CakeDC + phpstan-strict-rules + ShipMonk rules passing with 0 errors on PHP 8.5
limitations: Applies to src/, tests/, and config/ PHP source files

evidence.method: 184 PHPUnit tests and offline preview audit rendering 38 pages without broken links or duplicate IDs
limitations: Tested with MariaDB 11.8 on local loopback interface

claim.cs: Rekonstrukce parametrických těles z 3D skenů s fitováním základních geometrických primitiv a kontrolou odchylky.
claim.en: Parametric geometry reconstruction from 3D scan meshes with geometric primitive fitting and deviation inspection.

evidence.method: Dimensional deviation analysis on calibrated cylinder and plane scan fixtures
limitations: Beta prototype in private review; physical measurement certification not performed

claim.cs: Procedurální generování herního terénu s deterministickými seedy a validací grafové konektivity.
claim.en: Procedural game terrain generation with deterministic seeds and graph connectivity validation.

evidence.method: Deterministic seed terrain generator with A* path connectivity gate across layers
limitations: Standalone engine prototype; full gameplay mechanics not in scope

claim.cs: Správa společné fronty přehrávání s ochranou proti lost updates pomocí verzování záznamů a idempotence.
claim.en: Shared playback queue management with lost-update protection via record versioning and idempotency keys.

evidence.method: Concurrent queue push test simulating two clients: first commits version N+1, second detects conflict and performs rebase
limitations: Synthetic queue test; live Spotify Web API credentials excluded from test runner

claim.cs: Autoritativní síťový model pro kooperativní hru s validací verzí požadavků a obnovou po výpadku spojení.
claim.en: Authoritative networking model for cooperative gameplay with request version validation and reconnect synchronization.

evidence.method: Simulated client reconnect test verifying authoritative state re-snapshot without entity duplication
limitations: Tested in headless test harness; requires Software Inc runtime for game integration

claim.cs: Architektonický návrh distribuované tiskové fronty s asynchronním slicováním a řízením zakázek.
claim.en: Architectural proposal for distributed print queue with asynchronous slicing and job lifecycle management.

evidence.method: State machine model covering Submission -> Validation -> Queued -> Slicing -> Ready -> Printing -> Completed
limitations: Proposal and architecture design; automated production slicing not implemented

claim.cs: Provozní konfigurace Discord bota pod samostatným neprivilegovaným systémovým účtem se systemd a Ansible.
claim.en: Operations configuration for Discord bot under dedicated unprivileged system account with systemd and Ansible.

evidence.method: Ansible role provisioning systemd service with NoNewPrivileges=true and PrivateTmp=true
limitations: Bot token, guild IDs, and private server names redacted from public documentation
